summary.name: AmyMind
summary.one_liner: AmyMind is an AI mind map generator that converts text, Markdown, TXT, FreeMind, PDF, Word documents and YouTube captions into editable mind maps that can be exported to PowerPoint, PDF or Word.
use_cases: Turn lecture notes or study material into a visual mind map
Summarize a YouTube video with CC captions into a structured map
Convert a Markdown outline into a mind map
Export a mind map into a PowerPoint, PDF or Word document
Brainstorm and expand branches of an existing mind map with AI
summary.what_it_does: AmyMind converts pasted text and uploaded files (Markdown, TXT, FreeMind, PDF, Word) into mind maps using AI, preserving document hierarchy where applicable. Users can paste a YouTube URL to turn that video's captions into a structured mind map, provided the video has CC captions. The AI can generate new branches from a selected node, for example expanding "Coffee" into types and brewing methods. Selecting a branch returns more detailed information about it, and users can chat with the AI about their map for improvement suggestions. Maps can be exported to PowerPoint, PDF or Word.
notable: Accepts YouTube URLs and turns video captions into mind maps (requires CC captions)
AI branch generation and detailed info on selected nodes
Imports Markdown, TXT, FreeMind, PDF and Word files
Exports to PowerPoint, PDF and Word
caveats: YouTube feature only works on videos that have CC captions
Page describes the tool as free to try and to get started for free, but does not detail paid tier limits
